key_findings: R21 materialization and local continuum proof deficiencies from the intermediate snapshot are resolved.
No obvious fatal algebraic contradiction was identified in the local self-financing/continuum/price-transport chain during this audit.
The accurate R21 object is a restricted four-expert model-assisted stochastic policy construction, not a successful full-state NBO.
The full-domain complete-state feedback certificate remains about 7.278319 against the unchanged 0.01 objective.
The direct stochastic end-to-end configuration is more accurate at all four tested vertices and materially cheaper to generate.
The paper's representation ablation is confounded because it changes optimizer (Adam vs L-BFGS-B), initialization, and parameterization simultaneously.
The initial-to-final continuum-improvement theorem relies on synchronized corner initialization via identical initial slope/drift vectors.
The sharp local regret certificate remains a hybrid of learned-policy lower evaluation, analytic decoder, and inherited non-neural dual upper comparison.
